original.statement: The storage version of the ec2nodeclasses.karpenter.k8s.aws CRD changes from v1beta1 to v1; existing objects remain stored as v1beta1 until rewritten, so a storage version migration and a status.storedVersions update are needed before a later release removes v1beta1.

of.needed: whether existing EC2NodeClass objects are still stored as v1beta1 in etcd (status.storedVersions of the ec2nodeclasses.karpenter.k8s.aws CRD still lists v1beta1)

corrected.statement: The storage version of ec2nodeclasses.karpenter.k8s.aws changes from v1beta1 to v1. Environments are exposed if they have existing EC2NodeClass objects still stored as v1beta1 (status.storedVersions still lists v1beta1), whatever apiVersion their manifests use. Those objects need a storage version migration and a storedVersions update before a later release removes v1beta1.

decision.reason: The change text says the exposed state is existing EC2NodeClass objects that "stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten" in etcd. The proposed condition only checks whether manifests use the v1beta1 apiVersion, so it gets the exposure wrong in two ways. It misses clusters whose manifests already say v1 but still hold objects stored as v1beta1, and it flags v1beta1 manifests applied after the storage version changes, which are stored as v1. The evidence excerpts [ev-8998581760b8] [ev-451bd6a12e72] are empty CRD files from v0.37.8 and v1.0.0, and no static input shows how objects are stored or what status.storedVersions contains. So the condition needs EC2NodeClass in use plus an undecidable operand for storage state.
